 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, State and learned counsel for the informant.

This application has been filed for quashing of the order dated 12.09.2013 passed by Sub- divisional Judicial Magistrate, Pupari at Sitamarhi in Complaint Case No. C1-495 of 2012 (Tr. No. 1437 of 2013) by which the learned Court below took cognizance under Sections 420 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code against all the accused persons including the petitioners herein.
